Title: Generally Available: Enhanced Performance Guidance in Azure Advisor for Azure Database for PostgreSQL

Body.Content:
You can now proactively identify and resolve more performance scenarios in Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server using Azure Advisor recommendations. Three new Advisor recommendations are available, and improvements to existing recommendations provide more precise details. For example, long-running transactions now share the PID to troubleshoot—if bloat is high, now the database name is shared along with recommendations to mitigate. 

 

Learn more.
